author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: THE world, and all within it, is man’s conditioned consciousness objectified. Consciousness is the cause as well as the substance of the entire world. So it is to consciousness that we must turn if we would discover the secret of creation.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Consciousness is the one and only reality, not figuratively but actually.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: The conscious impresses the subconscious, while the subconscious expresses all that is impressed upon it.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: No idea can be impressed on the subconscious until it is felt, but once felt — be it good, bad or indifferent — it must be expressed. Feeling is the one and only medium through which ideas are conveyed to the subconscious.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: By control of feeling is not meant restraint or suppression of your feeling, but rather the disciplining of self to imagine and entertain only such feeling as contributes to your happiness.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: What you feel you are always dominates what you feel you would like to be; therefore, to be realized, the wish must be felt as a state that is rather than a state that is not.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Think feelingly only of the state you desire to realize. Feeling the reality of the state sought and living and acting on that conviction is the way of all seeming miracles.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: All changes of expression are brought about through a change of feeling. A change of feeling is a change of destiny.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: To impress the subconscious with the desirable state, you must assume the feeling that would be yours had you already realized your wish. In defining your objective, you must be concerned only with the objective itself.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: It is easier to ascribe your feeling to events in the world than to admit that the conditions of the world reflect your feeling. However, it is eternally true that the outside mirrors the inside.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: You are already that which you want to be, and your refusal to believe this is the only reason you do not see it.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Denying the evidence of the senses and appropriating the feeling of the wish fulfilled is the way to the realization of your desire.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: If you would realize your desire, you must feel the desire as already realized before you fall asleep.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Once asleep, man has no freedom of choice. His entire slumber is dominated by his last waking concept of self. It follows, therefore, that he should always assume the feeling of accomplishment and satisfaction before he retires in sleep.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: You are an eternal dreamer dreaming non-eternal dreams. Your dreams take form as you assume the feeling of their reality.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Do not limit yourself to the past. Knowing that nothing is impossible to consciousness, begin to imagine states beyond the experiences of the past.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Always use the imaginative process rather than the process of effort.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: In your imagination, go right to the end of your desire, feeling the thrill of having accomplished it.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Sleep is the door into heaven. What you take in as a feeling you bring out as a condition, action, or object in space. So sleep in the feeling of the wish fulfilled.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: To pray successfully then, you must yield to the wish, that is, feel the wish fulfilled.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Prayer is the art of assuming the feeling of being and having that which you want.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Prayer is the art of yielding to the wish and not the forcing of the wish. Whenever your feeling is in conflict with your wish, feeling will be the victor. The dominant feeling invariably expresses itself.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Prayer must be without effort. In attempting to fix an attitude of mind which is denied by the senses, effort is fatal.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: When this passive state is reached, imagine that you have realized your wish — not how it was realized, but simply the wish fulfilled. Imagine in picture form what you desire to achieve in life; then feel yourself as having already achieved it.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: All you can possibly need or desire is already yours. You need no helper to give it to you; it is yours now. Call your desires into being by imagining and feeling your wish fulfilled.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: As the end is accepted, you become totally indifferent as to possible failure, for acceptance of the end wills the means to that end.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: Get into the spirit of the state desired by assuming the feeling that would be yours were you already the one you want to be. As you capture the feeling of the state sought, you are relieved of all effort to make it so, for it is already so.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: You never attract that which you want but always that which you are. As a man is, so does he see.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: You are that which you believe yourself to be.
